caption: One servlet object lives through all three requests: init() runs once, each of the three GETs carries Anu and 78 and prints Anu scored 78, then destroy() runs once at shutdown. The console at the right shows the example's exact output lines.

spec.aria: A timeline with Browser, one Servlet object and Console: init() runs once, then three GET requests each carrying name Anu and marks 78 cause service() to print Anu scored 78, then service() calls equals 3 is printed and destroy() runs once at shutdown.
